name: Manuscript title page
description: The standard first page agents and editors expect, with contact details, word count and title.
css: .t-page{background:#fff;color:#000;padding:1in;font-size:12pt;line-height:1.2}.font-times .t-page,.font-times{font-family:'Times New Roman',Times,serif}.font-courier .t-page,.font-courier{font-family:'Courier Prime','Courier New',monospace}.tp{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.border-thin .tp{border:1px solid var(--borderColor);padding:.3in;margin:-.3in}.tp-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:.5in}.tp-wc{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}.tp-mid{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding-bottom:1.5in}.tp-mid h1{font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;margin:0 0 12pt}.titleCase-caps .tp-mid h1{text-transform:uppercase}.tp-mid p{margin:0 0 12pt}.tp-genre:empty{display:none}
